text:
Your vault is encrypted with AES-256, the same standard banks and governments use. The encryption key comes from your master password, run through PBKDF2 with 600,000 iterations. That makes every password guess slow and expensive for an attacker, even one with powerful hardware.

Your master password never leaves your device, and our servers never see it, so there's nothing for anyone to steal from us. The cloud only stores encrypted data, and you're the only one with the key to unlock it. You can still reach your passwords quickly from any of your devices, and your privacy stays protected.
